model_annotation: Figure 10 illustrates the effect of context masking on case tasks, grouped by language family. The horizontal axis displays the language families, presented in a categorical order, while the vertical axis represents the magnitude of the effect, scaled linearly with values ranging from 0 to 100 percent, with tick marks labeled at intervals of 20 percent. Each bar corresponds to a specific language family and is colored gray; the approximate heights of the bars indicate the percentage effect, with the shortest bar at approximately 10 percent and the tallest bar reaching approximately 90 percent. The chart does not show any grouping or stacking of bars, nor are any bars visually emphasized or annotated beyond their standard representation. Error bars, which indicate the standard deviation, are present above each bar but are not explicitly labeled with numerical values in the figure.
